He said human scientific progress has hit a J-curve, and flying cars are the beginning of it. BYD already built a car that jumps over potholes, and Tata and Mahindra are building low-cost EVs for India. My own theory is that Grok, especially a Super Grok only Elon has, already knows a lot, and it is helping his companies move fast.

I think India’s role over the next 10 to 15 years is to adapt this tech really fast and make affordable versions of it.

Would you buy a flying car? Tell me below. 👇

#FlyingCar #Tesla #BeerBiceps".
